lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Tuber treatment with Trichoderma viride or boric acid 3% solution.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check for potato tuber moth, scab, and dry rot in seed lots.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Use certified seed tubers (e.g. Kufri Pukhraj, Kufri Jyoti, Kufri Bahar) with 2-3 sprouted eyes.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 2. खेत की तैयारी एवं मेड़ बनाना
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Basal application of well-rotted FYM (20-25 t/ha) + full P, full K, and 50% N.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for cutworms and soil grubs.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Ensure deep, friable, loose sandy loam soil tilth.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Plant in moist ridges; do not flood.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Place fertilizer 4-5 cm away from seed tubers to prevent salt injury.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Plant seed tubers 5-7 cm deep with sprouts facing upward.
Water should not exceed 2/3rd height of ridges.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Regular furrow irrigation at 7-10 day intervals.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Top-dress remaining 50% Nitrogen (Urea) at earthing-up (30-35 DAP).
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Early Blight (Alternaria solani) concentric spots and aphids.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Perform earthing up properly to prevent developing tubers from turning green.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Critical moisture stage; maintain uniform furrow moisture.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Intensive scouting for Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) during overcast/foggy weather.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Avoid water stress or sudden drying during stolon swelling.

lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Foliar spray of Potassium Sulphate (0:0:50) @ 1% to improve tuber skin and solid content.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Late Blight lesions on stems and leaves.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Ensure tubers are fully covered with soil to avoid greening.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 8. छिलका सख्त होना एवं बेल काटना (Dehaulming)
lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Completely stop irrigation 10-12 days before cutting haulms.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Cut and remove aerial vines (haulms) 10-15 days before harvest.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Dehaulming is essential to harden the tuber skin for transit and storage.

lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Inspect dug tubers for cuts, rot, or potato tuber moth larvae.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Harvest in morning; cure tubers in shade for 7-10 days at 15-20°C.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 10. कटाई उपरांत प्रबंधन एवं कोल्ड स्टोरेज
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Monitor cold store temperature (3-4°C for seed, 8-10°C with CIPC for table/processing potato).
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Sort out damaged and rotted tubers before bagging.
